specs.name: Linear ETL Pipeline
specs.description: Simple left-to-right 5-stage ETL: Source DB -> Extract -> Transform -> Load -> Target DW. 1 zone (Data Platform), 5 boxes, 4 arrows.

specs.name: 3-Zone VPC Architecture
specs.description: Public subnet (ALB, NAT), Private subnet (App servers, Cache), Data subnet (RDS, ElastiCache). 3 zones, 8 boxes, 6 arrows showing traffic flow.

specs.name: Star/Hub-Spoke Integration
specs.description: Central API Gateway hub with 5 spoke services (Auth, Users, Orders, Inventory, Notifications). Hub in center, spokes radiate out. 1 zone, 6 boxes, 5 arrows.

specs.name: Vertical Stage Pipeline
specs.description: Top-to-bottom flow: Ingestion -> Staging -> Data Model -> Business Model -> Reporting. Each stage is a zone. 4 zones stacked vertically, 5 boxes, 4 arrows.

specs.name: Layered API Architecture
specs.description: 3-tier: Clients (Web, Mobile, API) -> Backend (Gateway, Auth, BFF) -> Data (PostgreSQL, Redis, S3). 3 zones, 9 boxes, 8 arrows.

specs.name: Long-Label Microservices
specs.description: 6 services with deliberately long names (e.g., 'Customer Relationship Management Service', 'Real-Time Event Processing Engine'). Tests text fitting in boxes. 2 zones, 6 boxes, 7 arrows with labels.

specs.name: Mesh Network Routing
specs.description: 6 nodes in a mesh where most nodes connect to most others. Tests arrow routing when paths are dense. 1 zone, 6 boxes, 12 arrows.

specs.name: Nested Zone Hierarchy
specs.description: Cloud Provider -> Region -> VPC -> Subnet -> Instance. 4 levels of nested zones. Tests zone label placement and opacity stacking. 4 nested zones, 4 boxes, 3 arrows.

specs.name: Mixed Line Styles
specs.description: System with batch (solid), real-time (dashed), monitoring (dotted) flows. 3 flow types between 6 components. Tests line style distinguishability. 2 zones, 6 boxes, 9 arrows (3 each style).

specs.name: Annotated Data Flow
specs.description: Pipeline with every arrow labeled (data format, volume, frequency). Tests arrow label placement. 1 zone, 5 boxes, 6 arrows all with multi-word labels.

specs.name: Feedback Loop System
specs.description: ML pipeline with feedback: Ingest -> Train -> Deploy -> Monitor -> back to Train. Circular flow tests arrow routing for return paths. 2 zones, 5 boxes, 5 arrows (one is return).

specs.name: Extreme Fan-Out
specs.description: Event bus publishing to 8 consumers. Tests arrow convergence at source and spacing at destinations. 2 zones, 9 boxes, 8 arrows all from same source.

specs.name: 5-Zone Enterprise
specs.description: DMZ, Application, Integration, Data, Monitoring zones. 5 zones with different colors, 10 boxes, 9 arrows crossing zone boundaries. Tests zone color differentiation.

specs.name: Deep Hierarchy
specs.description: Organization -> Department -> Team -> Service -> Component. 5 levels with 2-3 items per level. Tests indentation and spacing in hierarchical layout. 3 zones, 12 boxes, 11 arrows.

specs.name: Cross-Domain Data Flow
specs.description: 3 domains (Sales, Inventory, Finance) each with 2 services, connected by event bus and shared database. Tests arrows crossing multiple zones. 3 zones, 7 boxes, 10 arrows.

specs.name: Tight Spacing Challenge
specs.description: 8 small boxes in a 2x4 grid with minimal 15px gaps. Tests minimum spacing thresholds and text fitting in small containers. 1 zone, 8 boxes, 7 arrows.

specs.name: Bidirectional Cyclic Flow
specs.description: Request/response pattern: Client <-> Gateway <-> Service <-> Database. Each connection has forward and return arrows. Tests bidirectional arrow clarity. 1 zone, 4 boxes, 6 arrows.

specs.name: Symmetric Pipeline
specs.description: Two parallel processing paths (batch and streaming) with shared source and destination. Tests symmetry and parallel path alignment. 2 zones, 8 boxes, 8 arrows.

specs.name: Color-Coded Status System
specs.description: Monitoring dashboard: 4 services in green (healthy), 2 in yellow (degraded), 1 in red (down). Tests color differentiation and meaning conveyance. 2 zones, 7 boxes, 6 arrows.

specs.name: High-Contrast Zone Test
specs.description: 3 zones with deliberately different opacity levels (10%, 25%, 40% fill). Tests zone background visibility and text readability within zones. 3 zones, 6 boxes, 5 arrows.
